author: BIJU MATHEW
description: Indian cities face monsoon flooding despite extensive road construction projects.  Heavy rainfall overwhelms drainage systems, causing widespread traffic disruptions and damage.  Planned cities like Chandigarh also struggle with intense, short-duration rain events.  Underlying urban systems and natural water channels have not kept pace with development.  Addressing this requires improving drainage and preserving natural water bodies.
title: Bigger roads, flyovers and expressways but rain still brings cities to standstill

author: TOI BUSINESS DESK
description: In fact, the rupee’s decline over the years, strict valuation requirements and the fact that many amounts exceed the prescribed lower limits are discouraging several taxpayers from disclosing previously unreported foreign income and assets.

author: TOI SCIENCE DESK
description: Apollo 15 astronauts discovered an unusually bright rock near Spur Crater on the Moon.  This sample, known as the Genesis Rock, is an anorthosite and about four billion years old.  Scientists believe it represents a piece of the Moon's primordial crust.  Its mineral composition offers valuable clues about early lunar geological history.  This ancient sample continues to aid understanding of the Moon's evolution.
title: Apollo 15 astronauts found 4-billion-year-old 'Genesis Rock' on the Moon

author: TOI WORLD DESK
description: Following a five-month recovery from severe drought conditions, platypuses were reintroduced to their original habitats. In an eighteen-month study, researchers tracked their activities as they reintegrated into the wild. The animals displayed quick adaptation, rediscovering their typical movement patterns and preferred foraging spots, thereby emphasizing the importance of effective conservation efforts for aquatic wildlife amidst environmental stressors.
title: Scientists rescued platypuses from drought; they readapted within days

author: TOI ENTERTAINMENT DESK
description: Yash's 'Toxic: A Fairytale For Grown-Ups' has stormed past the Rs 100 crore mark on its opening day itself, and early Day 2 numbers suggest the film is set to build on that momentum as it chases even bigger box office milestones. The Geetu Mohandas directed gangster drama now has its sights set on an even bigger run through its first weekend and beyond.
title: Toxic Day 2: Can Yash's film cross Rs 150 cr after record opening?

author: TOI TECH DESK
description: Australian researchers developed an AI robot named Fletch to help trainee teachers.  Fletch simulates difficult parent conversations, allowing practice in a safe environment.  This robot adapts its responses, making interactions feel more realistic for educators.  It aims to reduce teacher stress and improve retention rates in schools.  La Trobe University and several Victorian schools will use Fletch for training purposes.

Despite the recent dip, prices have risen significantly year-to-date.

description: A Perth homeowner says he was unaware that the real estate agents hired to sell his home also owned the company that bought it for $705,000. Chao “Jack” Wu later discovered the connection through corporate records and said he believed the property was undersold. A retrospective valuation put its value at $800,000, while the agents disputed the valuation and denied wrongdoing. Western Australia’s Consumer Protection issued a formal warning to the agency over an alleged conflict of interest.

Friends and relatives mentioned that the trainer frequently sought her attention. Authorities have heightened security and are on a manhunt for the elusive suspect.

description: After three decades of dedicated conservation efforts, the Galápagos snapdragon, a critically endangered species, is showing promising signs of recovery. The emergence of natural seedlings in their habitat marks a pivotal breakthrough, revitalizing hope for the species’ future.

A Dallas judge has extended a temporary restraining order while considering the custody dispute.

description: In a landmark decision, California's Supreme Court dismissed a town's claim regarding the use of eminent domain for utility purposes. This shift significantly impacts how courts will weigh municipal efforts to take over private utility companies, allowing private water, gas, and electricity firms to challenge such actions more effectively.
